EDfx_output.observation: Exact EDfx match, non-null selected NATION/type 10, separate context/object/output args.
The comp test gates preparation of an in-memory rule wrapper; a2d350 uses +0x18 if non-null, otherwise hunts comp in the supplied object.
Remove matching cached entry by pointer, attach +0x1c0 at wrapper+0x38, then call evaluation helper. Not a file open.
Prepare calendar context for year; obtains in-memory entries and calls per-entry helper.
Pass NATION+0x108 backlink as R9, not as this or as a stream. Both date arguments point to the same day.
Query day-bucket vectors starting at calendar this+0x38 (editor context+0x1f8); conditional filter compares backlink against in-memory record relationships.
Append a projected row (including fallback), then box/move UI list to caller, no observed serialization of the generated list.

EDsc_dispatch_and_consumers.observation: Generic UI caller passes computed key + selected object and on success inserts the returned value under the original key. Does not prove which external schema instance invokes this at runtime.
One verified indirect edge: EDsc selects rel32 slot 0x32; see xref.json for table bytes and neighboring controls.
Context gate: AL=0 takes empty success; otherwise requires non-null selected object, BPL=0 and global context+0x54c nonzero. Then split type 25/other.
COMP/type25 enters schedule consumer with R9B=1; preserved into collector (not an archive client/server mode).
Collector conditionally prepares shared context+0x1c0 from context-side entries, iterates and builds schedule items. Conditions retained; not all run together.
COMP-side wrapper processes temporary results and moves boxed output to caller.
Non-25 rechecks type: only NATION/type10 enters alternate schedule consumer; other types reject via 0x2a684.
Nation wrapper may return empty value; otherwise enumerates inputs, delegates per picked competition with R9D=0, appends projected rows and returns boxed list.

limits: Selected-key dispatch replay starts after the prologue, not a runtime claim or a general symbolic engine.
CFG: no call traversal except explicit hops; unknown indirect branches and extent-external edges are preserved, not dead.
Context gates and R9 helper flag are not an archive-mode result.
